messages:
emily (docs): Heads up — I opened a docs PR to add a new model card for Cascade-7B and some related catalog entries. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :tada:
raj (ml): awesome. does this include the int8 quant profile we tested last week?
lena (sdk): I skimmed — SDK snippets are in, but the Python streaming example uses the old `client.generate_stream` signature. will update to the new `stream_responses` param.
emily (docs): good catch @lena. I'll patch the snippet. also added a short migration note for Dedicated customers about required runtime >= 2.3.0 for long-context support. @ben can you confirm that cutoff?
ben (runtime): correct — long-context (64k) sliding-window and the new KV cache eviction are runtime 2.3.0+. older runtimes will get truncated responses. we should add a clear compatibility note.
emily (docs): added a bold compatibility callout in the card, but feel free to suggest wording.
chris (pm): pls include guidance on cost tradeoffs for 64k contexts (tokens & memory). customers ask about latency too. a quick example cost calc would be helpful.
raj (ml): i can add a short benchmark table — throughput for 1k/8k/64k average seq with fp16 vs int8. ran local bench on p4d-ish:
```
Cascade-7B fp16 1k: 1200 tok/s
Cascade-7B fp16 8k: 850 tok/s
Cascade-7B fp16 64k: 220 tok/s
Cascade-7B int8 1k: 900 tok/s
Cascade-7B int8 8k: 700 tok/s
Cascade-7B int8 64k: 180 tok/s
```
raj (ml): numbers are noisy but directionally useful for the card. i'll push a short table in the PR.
sophia (qa): can we include the eval prompts used for those benches? helps with reproducibility.
raj (ml): will attach the prompt set and the bench script.
lena (sdk): updated the Python snippet — using new streaming call and added a streaming chunk handler example. also added a JS snippet variant. here's the Python snippet I plan to commit:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
# streaming example for long-context
with client.stream_responses(model='cascade-7b', max_new_tokens=512) as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text, end='')
```
emily (docs): perfect. i'll swap the old snippet out. can someone run link-checker? PR flagged a broken example link per CI.
doc-bot: link-checker: found 1 broken link in docs/catalog/cascade7b.md line 58 -> https://old-hosting.example.com/assets/cascade-bench.png
emily (docs): thanks doc-bot — i'll replace with a local asset and update the path.
ben (runtime): small runtime note: for Private installs that disable autoscaling, the recommended batch size defaults may need lowering; added a short note in the compat section.
chris (pm): add a 'Known differences vs other 7B models' bullet list (latency/throughput/quant friendliness). helps sales and SEs.
emily (docs): will draft that. raj, can you add a short line about quant sensitivity?
raj (ml): yep — cascade7b is fairly robust to QAT int8 and RTT-int8; suggested quant profile is `int8-fast` for throughput-first, `fp16` for latency-sensitive. i'll add a note.
sophia (qa): after edits i'll run a quick doc smoke test and example run locally. ETA 3pm PT.
lena (sdk): one more: ensure snippets use the pinned `models/cascade-7b:1.0.0` style reference — we discovered inconsistent variant names previously.
emily (docs): done. switched to canonical model-id in all snippets.
raj (ml): PR also mentions streaming tok-chunking behavior for library clients — good to clarify that chunk boundaries are not token-aligned and may split code blocks. small note under 'Streaming' section.
emily (docs): added a short warning.
chris (pm): LGTM once bench table, snippets fixed, and runtime note confirmed. can we aim to merge by EOD today?
sophia (qa): will verify examples and bench attachments by 5pm PT.
ben (runtime): i'll add a short runtime-compatible mapping to the PR so ops knows which runtime image supports which features.
emily (docs): thank you all. I'll make the final edits and request reviews from @raj and @lena.
lena (sdk): quick approve from SDK side when pushed. :+1:
emily (docs): done — updated PR with fixes and resolved link. ready for final pass: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:
raj (ml): approving bench section now. :shipit:
emily (docs): merging after QA sign-off. thanks team! :tada:
